Redfin is a technology-driven real estate company creating an integrated homeownership platform from search to close. The Software Developer I - Search will build consumer-facing home search features, data ingestion pipelines, and data services for high-traffic Redfin.com platforms, while collaborating with a full-stack team and supporting production systems through an on-call rotation when required.

Responsibilities
Our team develops on the Home Details Page and the Search map, the two highest traffic pages for Redfin.com
Our full-stack team builds highly visible consumer facing UI as well as robust data ingestion pipelines and data services
This role may include participation in an on-call rotation to support production systems and ensure service reliability
On-call responsibilities may include coverage during nights and weekends

Full-Stack Development

Required
You are a developer with 1 or more years of experience developing full-stack, customer-facing applications
You keep up with the ever-changing landscape of providing delightful User Interfaces - we use React
You have experience being part of a team developing large scale apps backed by relational databases - we use Java, Spring, Hibernate, and Postgres
You're curious and a life-long learner: you're willing to take risks and champion new ideas
Maybe you already have some genAI ideas for the real estate world?
You are excited to grow your technical and project leadership skills
You live and breathe a culture of service to customers, operational partners and teammates
Above all, you share a passion for our mission to create a fundamentally better real estate experience for our customers
